# GEO Citation Tracker

`geo-citation-tracker` · v1.0.0 · Execute · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/geo-citation-tracker/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Are AI answer engines actually naming and citing our brand, and is the change since the last run real or noise?

**Inputs:** The brand, its category prompts, the engines to track, the competitors to track against — and, for a readout, the logged result of each prompt on each engine

**Output:** A required prompt-set size, or a scored run giving presence rate, citation rate, rank-weighted visibility, share of voice, framing, and an explicit verdict on whether movement since the last run is real

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill geo-citation-tracker`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/geo-citation-tracker/resources/citation-tracker.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/geo-citation-tracker/resources/citation-tracker.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It does not query any engine. It scores the results you log by hand, so it is only as good as those logs; a partial log means a smaller n and a wider noise floor.
- Small prompt sets detect only large swings. In the demo, 40 prompts could only reliably detect a 29-point change; movement inside that floor is not a result.
- Answers vary by day and model version, so a jump can come from an engine update rather than your work. Comparisons break if the prompt set changes between runs.
- It measures presence and citation in answers, not clicks or revenue. Pair it with analytics before claiming impact.

**Review before acting:** Whoever ran the prompts confirms every row was actually observed on the same frozen prompt set, with run date and model version logged. The marketing lead reports presence and citation separately, with the noise floor stated.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/geo-citation-tracker](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/geo-citation-tracker)
